description: Clinical evaluation reference table supplied by the user. The application reads interpretation labels, thresholds and improvement rules from this file. Bands are inclusive integer ranges; a fractional score (for example a mean-imputed PDI) uses the band whose minimum it has reached.

PEG.interpretation: Tracking metric; compare over time, not diagnostic.

guardrail.label: URGENT ACTION TRIGGER: PHQ-9 item 9 >= 1 overrides the total score; high risk for self-harm flagged

ORT-OUD.metric: Sum of 9 equally weighted Yes/No risk factors
ORT-OUD.scoring_note: The supplied table lists a 0-26 sex-weighted range, which describes the original 2005 ORT. No sex weights were supplied, and the scanned forms use the 9 equally weighted Yes/No ORT-OUD factors, so the score stays 0-9 and the supplied threshold (<3 / >=3) is applied.

bands.label: Low risk for Opioid Use Disorder
High risk for Opioid Use Disorder

COMM.metric: Sum of 17 items scored 0-4; standard form only
COMM.table_as_supplied: Not in the supplied table; earlier supplied rule retained

bands.label: Negative current-misuse screen (<9); does not rule out misuse. Continue appropriate monitoring.
Positive current-misuse screen (>=9); further clinician assessment is warranted, not a diagnosis.

COMM.modified_form_label: Modified form: standard COMM threshold not applied; interpretation requires version-specific rules.
